title: Classroom Picture Parade
hook: Find the tool, then put the idea back where it belongs.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
responseSpace: one to two predictable beats of retrieval space before target confirmation
visualStyle: clean 3D classroom storybook, colorful supplies, simple desks, isolated objects; visual identity: Classroom Picture Parade

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a child mapping where classroom supplies belong
creativeFingerprint.round2Grammar: neutral recall -> exact target -> safe point/shape action
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Turn Classroom Picture Parade into an organization walk: supplies move from carry-in to work surface, reference area, storage, and return-home positions, so objects have jobs instead of merely marching past.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A child follows where classroom objects belong and why; organization becomes the narrative spine, with tools that can cut, stain, or store data given explicit boundaries.
